title: What If You Could See 60 Seconds Ahead? 🤯
description:
What if you could see exactly 60 seconds into the future? ⏱️

In this AI-animated cartoon, Pip discovers he can see one minute ahead — and quickly learns that knowing the future isn't as fun as it sounds. From dodging a falling ball to "predicting" a coin flip, things spiral until a real physics fact flips the whole premise on its head.

🎬 Made 100% with FREE AI tools:
• OpenCode (free, open-source) + GLM-5.3-Flash Free model
• Remotion (free for individuals) — every frame drawn in code
• ElevenLabs (free tier) — voice + sound effects
• Python + FFmpeg (free) — scripting + mastering to -14 LUFS

No Claude subscription. No image model. No video model. No drawing. Just one line of text → full animated episode.

⏱️ Timestamps:
0:00 - Cold open (3 demos)
0:05 - Title card
0:10 - The fun begins
0:18 - The turn (real fact)
0:21 - End
